sentences.en: I ran to school, but the bell had already rung.
sentences.zh: 我跑到学校时，铃声已经响了。

sentences.en: The bell had already rung when I got to school.
sentences.zh: 当我到达学校时，铃声已经响起。

sentences.en: I had hardly reached the school when the bell rang.
sentences.zh: 我才刚到校门口，铃声就响了起来。

phrases.zh: 引起共鸣（表示某事听起来熟悉或有意义）

senses.zh: 钟, 铃, 电铃；钟声, 铃声
贝尔(①姓氏 ②Alexander Graham, 1847-1922, 生于苏格兰的美国科学家, 电话发明者)
